title: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated (UNH) — Integrated Healthcare Underwriting, Actuarial Reset & Stage 3 Patience Dossier
primer: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) pairs 48.3 million insurance members with Optum's $270 billion care, data, and pharmacy engine. After a tough 2025 reset, 9M 2026 operating profit rose 27% to $23.54 billion, with $22.67 billion in free cash flow. At $389.68 (16.63x forward earnings), the stock prices in just 3.8% annual cash flow growth against our $465.00 Base Case target. Because UNH sits in Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback)—below its 30W/50D SMAs while +6.0% above its 200D SMA—inside a market Downtrend and is NOT_HELD, we hold 100% cash and wait for $365.30–$376.42 support or a $398.33 reclaim.
holding_rationale: Verified 0 shares and 0 options held in UNH across all tracked US brokerage accounts (Charles Schwab and Robinhood; consolidated net worth $82,808.19 with $64,110.88 equities, $14,878.43 options, and $3,818.88 cash). No existing position requires trimming or exit management; new capital remains in cash pending support stabilization inside $365.30–$376.42 or a confirmed 30-week SMA reclaim above $398.33.

holding_alerts.instruction: Monitor UNH inside $365.30–$376.42 (200D SMA $367.58 / Pivot S1 $370.86); initiate first 3.5% Core Alpha tranche only after 4H EMA20 reclaim and 4H RSI > 45, with hard stop at $358.00.
Upgrade posture from WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT to ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP if UNH reclaims the 30-week SMA ($398.33) and 10-week EMA ($396.46) on weekly volume >= 1.2x average.
Cancel pending support limit bids if UNH closes below $365.05 on elevated volume or if DOJ/CMS regulatory news impairs FY2027 EPS below $20.00.
